body:
Is Weed Supposed to Do This?
Allow me to introduce myself: I am a 19-year-old male college student.  I have been using marijuana since age 15 and ecstacy since age 18(have also tried Nitrous and DXM once each, but that's irrelevant).
Anyway, on with my story:  It was Thanksgiving break, and I was so excited to be going home after 3 months away at college.  I knew the one thing I wanted to do most when I got back was go to a rave, since there are none that I know of out here where I go to college.  I have been raving about as long as I have been doing E(about 9 months), but hadn't been to one since I started college.  Upon arriving home, I called up a friend of mine who is both a raver and an ecstacy dealer.  He said there was one going on that night, and so that night, I picked him up at his house(he didn't have a car) and we went to the rave, which turned out to be an hour away!  Oh well.  We went anyway.  My friend had a new batch of Yellow Alligator pills that he was going to sell that night.(Note: he didn't drop any himself, as he was on a hiatus from all drugs except weed)
When we arrived at the place, I paid him for the pill, which I took in the parking lot.  Wow, this place was packed!  It took so long to get in that I was still waiting in line when my pill kicked in!  Anyway, we did finally get in, and I felt great!  It had been such a long time since had rolled!  One thing terribly wrong about this rave, though: Security were really a bunch of ASSHOLES!  This was even my observation while I was rolling, and if you think someone's an asshole when you're rolling, then they're a MAJOR asshole.  Anyway, that didn't bother me too much, though I did sympathize with the people who got busted that night.(mostly for drugs, I assume)  I still had a great time and met some new friends.
On the way back, my friend drove, since he was sober.  I was starting to come down, but still wasn't at baseline yet(The great thing about Yellow Alligator pills is that, despite their strength, they have a very easy comedown, as opposed to the crash experienced on other pills)  Anyway, my friend knew this one weed dealer(his boss's son), so we went to his house.(This was about 2:30am, but this guy tends to stay up late)  About this time, I think I was sober, but I wasn't quite sure.  I might have still been in the process of coming down.  Anyway, my friend bought some weed off of him, and we smoked it out of his 6-foot bong.  The largest bong I had ever smoked out of was 2 feet, and that one got me pretty fucked up, so I couldn't wait to see what a six-footer would do.  I filled the chamber with smoke, and after catching my breath, inhaled all six feet of smoke.
After the worst coughing fit of my life, I drank some water and lied down on the couch.  WOW!  This was the most stoned I'd ever been!  I didn't know weed could have this effect.  I was curled up on the couch in fetal position, barely able to move, and staring blankly at my friend and the dealer(they were really stoned too, but not as much as I was).  My mind was going a million miles an hour, and I started to hallucinate...not like you do on acid or shrooms(I think, but I've never tried either of them, so I wouldn't know for sure), but in another way.  As I was looking at these two people sitting on the couch, and it looked as if I was watching a movie.  Then I looked at some of the posters on the wall, and the people in them seemed to be alive...not that they were moving, but they just seemed to be interacting with me in some way.  Interesting: it seemed that I was observing the people in the room, but interacting with the posters.  You know, I always thought that E was so much stronger than weed, but in this case, I dare say that the weed fucked me up even more (and the pills were pretty strong, too).
